sentences.text: In short: STIFTELSEN TREKLANG MONTESSORI is an established small company in "førskoleundervisning og drift av barnehager" based in Oslo, loss-making in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.

STIFTELSEN TREKLANG MONTESSORI is a foundation (STI), founded on 2004-12-30, registered in Oslo.
It has 22 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 7.60M for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 319,016 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of -4.2% and a strong equity ratio of 52% of total assets.

Revenue rose 3.5% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 7.35M to NOK 7.60M); it was NOK 6.73M in 2023. The annual result was a loss in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: -NOK 137,732, 2024: -NOK 159,781, 2025: -NOK 281,271).
STIFTELSEN TREKLANG MONTESSORI is led by CEO Ingrid Anna Marie Eriksson and board chair Cecilie Broch Knudsen.
It has a board of 4. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-01-31 (within the past year).
STIFTELSEN TREKLANG MONTESSORI has a verified website (https://treklang.no/) and 1 registered workplace.
